instruction: Get the first 7 emails from the daily folder in Thunderbird, sort them by ascending time, and create a spreadsheet "first_seven.xlsx" on the Desktop with these columns: sender_name, subject, date, and CC.

command: wmctrl -a calc || wmctrl -a Calc || xdotool search --name calc windowactivate || true
import pyautogui; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); import time; time.sleep(1)
